name: Southwick Hill Tunnel
facts: Southwick Hill Tunnel, a 490‑metre twin‑bore road tunnel, opened in early 1996 as part of the A27 Brighton bypass, slicing neatly beneath Southwick Hill.
Constructed through the Newhaven Chalk layer with the New Austrian Tunnelling method, the tunnel relies on shotcrete and untensioned bolts for structural integrity.
Non‑motorised traffic and mopeds under 50 cc are barred from Southwick Hill Tunnel, with a warning sign directing them to an alternative route.
